defects_found.what: 'the started-and-left ceiling, and whether it moves between the two extremes' admits two readings. Under the envelope reading (the adopted one) each endpoint is a separate worst case and the ceiling is unchanged: 16,843 DERIV / 19,745 APPLY. Under a joint-state reading, where both endpoints are evaluated in the one world 'all channel pairs are truly Continued', the ceiling would be 16,754 -> 11.3687% DERIV and 19,655 -> 9.9947% APPLY.
defects_found.why_it_is_a_defect: the four joint-state numbers are derivable from the same files and are NOT bound endpoints. Named here so a later instance cannot derive them and mistake them for the ceiling.
defects_found.verdict: the proposed table is CORRECT under the envelope reading, which is what a bound means
